report.paragraph:
Conversation timestamp: 2026-09-24 2:13 PM EDT
Topic: PBeam spreadsheet update / bearing DL & LL reconciliation

Updated bearing spreadsheet from both Mathcad runs and project data. Confirmed LL is pedestrian load only; DL should represent full permanent superstructure reaction at each individual bearing. PSBeam’s DL already closely matches beam + deck + haunch + parapet/fence + forms, so those loads should not be added again. FB-MultiPier node gravity combines adjacent span bearing reactions and separate cap/pedestal/cheek-wall effects.

Was worried the DL and LL were from the PSBeam Program and weren't capturing the true structure. The assumptions in the program match the true structure closely enough to not bother using actual structure loads of the Fencing and so forth.
Discussed the bearing pad width currently at 42" but bigger then required N values and came to the conclusion its a reasonable width.

Discussed with Matt the allowable transverse deflection at the pier. SDG 10.2.G.4 says span/500. Assuming the "span" for the pier is both connected spans especially since the slab is continuous we are going to call the limit
BridgeGeometry_2Beam.TotalSpan/500 to in = 5.094 in

section.heading: 2026-10-12 — Terrain elevations at support centerlines
section.paragraph: Existing ground at the intersection of each support cap/pile centerline with the bridge centerline. Elevations are US survey feet, NAVD88. Horizontal reference: FL83/2011-EF (NAD83(2011), Florida East, US survey feet), confirmed by the user.

Station labels follow the native model. End-bent cap/pile centerline stations differ from the front-face-of-backwall profile limits. This is a dated measurement record; no existing terrain input or design calculation is replaced.

Source: saved B4 Pedestrian Bridge and Ramps — Pond14D — Source Update 20261010.FCStd; ExistingTerrainB4 / Ex_I-95_Middle. Physical cap and pile centerlines, mesh-face interpolation and agreement with the original survey triangles passed the recorded geometry checks. The model was not changed or saved.
Full-precision calculation and source checks: tasks/T007/sources/support-terrain-elevations.json (repository root).
Lookup values are not structural design approval. Existing model coordination issues and unrelated calculations were not rechecked.
